verses.en: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.fr: Le huitième mois, la seconde année de Darius, la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Zacharie, fils de Bérékia, fils d''Iddo, le prophète, en ces mots:
verses.am: በዳርዮስ በሁለተኛው ዓመት በስምንተኛው ወር የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ አዶ ልጅ ወደ በራክዩ ልጅ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ዘካርያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: The Lord hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a été très irrité contre vos pères.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአባቶቻችሁ ላይ እጅግ ተቈጥቶ ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Dis-leur donc: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Revenez à moi, dit l''Eternel des armées, et je reviendrai à vous, dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እንዲህ በላቸው። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ እኔም ወደ እናንተ እመለሳለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ne soyez pas comme vos pères, auxquels s''adressaient les premiers prophètes, en disant: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Détournez-vous de vos mauvaises voies, de vos mauvaises actions! Mais ils n''écoutèrent pas, ils ne firent pas attention à moi, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የቀደሙት ነቢያት ለአባቶቻችሁ እንዲህ ብለው ሰብከዋል። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከክፉ መንገዳችሁና ከክፉ ሥራችሁ ተመለሱ፤ እነርሱ ግን አልሰሙም፥ እኔንም አላደመጡም፤ እንደ እነርሱ አትሁኑ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
verses.fr: Vos pères, où sont-ils? et les prophètes pouvaient-ils vivre éternellement?
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁ ወዴት ናቸው? ነቢያትስ ለዘላለም በሕይወት ይኖራሉን?

verses.en: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the Lord of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.
verses.fr: Cependant mes paroles et les ordres que j''avais donnés à mes serviteurs, les prophètes, n''ont-ils pas atteint vos pères? Ils se sont retournés, et ils ont dit: L''Eternel des armées nous a traités comme il avait résolu de le faire selon nos voies et nos actions.
verses.am: ለባሪያዎቼስ ለነቢያት ያዘዝኋቸው ቃሎቼና ሥርዓቴ በአባቶቻችሁ ላይ አልደረሱምን? እነርሱም ተመልሰው። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በመንገዳችንና በሥራችን መጠን ያደርግብን ዘንድ እንዳሰበ እንዲሁ አድርጎብናል አሉ።

verses.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.fr: Le vingt-quatrième jour du onzième mois, qui est le mois de Schebat, la seconde année de Darius, la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Zacharie, fils de Bérékia, fils d''Iddo, le prophète, en ces mots:
verses.am: በዳርዮስ በሁለተኛው ዓመት ሳባጥ በሚባል በአሥራ አንደኛው ወር በሀያ አራተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ አዶ ልጅ ወደ በራክዩ ልጅ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ዘካርያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
verses.fr: Je regardai pendant la nuit, et voici, un homme était monté sur un cheval roux, et se tenait parmi des myrtes dans un lieu ombragé; il y avait derrière lui des chevaux roux, fauves, et blancs.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሰው በመጋላ ፈረስ ተቀምጦ በሌሊት አየሁ፥ እርሱም በሸለቆው ውስጥ ባሉ በባርሰነት ዛፎች መካከል ቆሞ ነበር፤ በስተ ኋላውም መጋላና ሐመር አንባላይም ፈረሶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.
verses.fr: Je dis: Qui sont ces chevaux, mon seigneur? Et l''ange qui parlait avec moi me dit: Je te ferai voir qui sont ces chevaux.
verses.am: እኔም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ምንድር ናቸው? አልሁ። ከእኔም ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረው መልአክ። እነዚህ ምን እንደ ሆኑ አሳይሃለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the Lord hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
verses.fr: L''homme qui se tenait parmi les myrtes prit la parole et dit: Ce sont ceux que l''Eternel a envoyés pour parcourir la terre.
verses.am: በባርሰነት ዛፎች መካከልም ቆሞ የነበረው ሰው። እነዚህ በምድር ላይ ይመላለሱ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር የላካቸው ናቸው ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: And they answered the angel of the Lord that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.
verses.fr: Et ils s''adressèrent à l''ange de l''Eternel, qui se tenait parmi les myrtes, et ils dirent: Nous avons parcouru la terre, et voici, toute la terre est en repos et tranquille.
verses.am: በባርሰነት ዛፎች መካከልም ቆሞ የነበረውን የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ። በምድር ላይ ተመላለስን፥ እነሆም፥ ምድር ሁሉ ዝም ብላ ዐርፋ ተቀምጣለች ብለው መለሱለት።

verses.en: Then the angel of the Lord answered and said, O Lord of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?
verses.fr: Alors l''ange de l''Eternel prit la parole et dit: Eternel des armées, jusques à quand n''auras-tu pas compassion de Jérusalem et des villes de Juda, contre lesquelles tu es irrité depuis soixante-dix ans?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ መልሶ። አቤቱ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ሰባ ዓመት የተቈጣሃቸውን ኢየሩሳሌምንና የይሁዳን ከተሞች የማትምራቸው እስከ መቼ ነው? አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit par de bonnes paroles, par des paroles de consolation, à l''ange qui parlait avec moi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መልሶ ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር ለነበረው መልአክ በመልካምና በሚያጽናና ቃል ተናገረው።

verses.en: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
verses.fr: Et l''ange qui parlait avec moi me dit: Crie, et dis: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Je suis ému d''une grande jalousie pour Jérusalem et pour Sion,
verses.am: ስለዚህም ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረው መልአክ እንዲህ አለኝ። ስበክ እንዲህም በል። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ በታላቅ ቅንዓት በኢየሩሳሌምና በጽዮን ቀንቻለሁ።

verses.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
verses.fr: et je suis saisi d''une grande irritation contre les nations orgueilleuses; car je n''étais que peu irrité, mais elles ont contribué au mal.
verses.am: እኔ ጥቂት ብቻ ተቈጥቼ ሳለሁ እነርሱ ክፋትን ስላገዙት፥ ባልተቸገሩት አሕዛብ ላይ እጅግ ተቈጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the Lord of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ainsi parle l''Eternel: Je reviens à Jérusalem avec compassion; ma maison y sera rebâtie, et le cordeau sera étendu sur Jérusalem.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በምሕረት ተመልሻለሁ፤ ቤቴ ይሠራባታል፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ ገመድ ይዘረጋበታል፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the Lord shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Crie de nouveau, et dis: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Mes villes auront encore des biens en abondance; l''Eternel consolera encore Sion, il choisira encore Jérusalem.
verses.am: ደግሞም እንዲህ ስትል ስበክ። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከተሞቼ ደግሞ በበጎ ነገር ይረካሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ጽዮንን ያጽናናል፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ደግሞ ይመርጣል።

verses.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
verses.fr: Je levai les yeux et je regardai, et voici, il y avait quatre cornes.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼንም አንሥቼ እነሆ፥ አራት ቀንዶች አየሁ።

verses.en: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Je dis à l''ange qui parlait avec moi: Qu''est-ce que ces cornes? Et il me dit: Ce sont les cornes qui ont dispersé Juda, Israël et Jérusalem.
verses.am: ከእኔም ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረውን መልአክ። እነዚህ ምንድር ናቸው? አልሁት። እርሱም። እነዚህ ይሁዳንና እስራኤልን ኢየሩሳሌምንም የበተኑ ቀንዶች ናቸው ብሎ መለሰልኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord shewed me four carpenters.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me fit voir quatre forgerons.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አራት ጠራቢዎች አሳየኝ።

verses.en: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
verses.fr: Je dis: Que viennent-ils faire? Et il dit: Ce sont les cornes qui ont dispersé Juda, tellement que nul ne lève la tête; et ces forgerons sont venus pour les effrayer, et pour abattre les cornes des nations qui ont levé la corne contre le pays de Juda, afin d''en disperser les habitants.
verses.am: እኔም። እነዚህ የመጡት ምን ሊሠሩ ነው? አልሁ። እርሱም። አንድ ሰው ራሱን እስከማያነሣ ድረስ እነዚህ ቀንዶች ይሁዳን የበተኑ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ ግን ሊያስፈራሩአቸው፥ የይሁዳንም አገር ይበትኑ ዘንድ ቀንዳቸውን ያነሡትን የአሕዛብን ቀንዶች ሊጥሉ መጥተዋል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.fr: Je levai les yeux et je regardai, et voici, il y avait un homme tenant dans la main un cordeau pour mesurer.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼንም አነሣሁ፤ እነሆም፥ በእጁ የመለኪያ ገመድ የያዘ አንድ ሰውን አየሁ።

verses.en: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
verses.fr: Je dis: Où vas-tu? Et il me dit: Je vais mesurer Jérusalem, pour voir de quelle largeur et de quelle longueur elle doit être.
verses.am: እኔም። አንተ ወዴት ትሄዳለህ? አልሁ። እርሱም። የኢየሩሳሌምን ወርድና ርዝመት ስንት መሆኑን ሰፍሬ አይ ዘንድ እሄዳለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.fr: Et voici, l''ange qui parlait avec moi s''avança, et un autre ange vint à sa rencontre.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረው መልአክ ወጣ፥ ሌላም መልአክ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥

verses.en: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Cours, parle à ce jeune homme, et dis: Jérusalem sera une ville ouverte, à cause de la multitude d''hommes et de bêtes qui seront au milieu d''elle;
verses.am: እንዲህም አለው። ሩጥ፥ ይህንም ጕልማሳ እንዲህ በለው። ኢየሩሳሌም በውስጥዋ ካሉት ሰዎችና እንስሶች ብዛት የተነሣ ቅጥር እንደሌላቸው መንደሮች ሆና ትኖራለች።

verses.en: For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.fr: je serai pour elle, dit l''Eternel, une muraille de feu tout autour, et je serai sa gloire au milieu d''elle.
verses.am: እኔ በዙሪያዋ የእሳት ቅጥር እሆንላታለሁ፥ በውስጥዋም ክብርን እሆናለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Fuyez, fuyez du pays du septentrion! Dit l''Eternel. Car je vous ai dispersés aux quatre vents des cieux, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እናንተ ሆይ፥ ከሰሜን ምድር ሽሹ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እንደ አራቱ የሰማይ ነፍሳት በትኛችኋለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
verses.fr: Sauve-toi, Sion, Toi qui habites chez la fille de Babylone!
verses.am: አንቺ ከባቢሎን ሴት ልጅ ጋር የምትኖሪ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ኰብልዪ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Après cela, viendra la gloire! Il m''a envoyé vers les nations qui vous ont dépouillés; Car celui qui vous touche touche la prunelle de son oeil.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። ከክብሩ በኋላ ወደ በዘበዙአችሁ አሕዛብ ልኮኛል፤ የሚነካችሁ የዓይኑን ብሌን የሚነካ ነውና።

verses.en: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.
verses.fr: Voici, je lève ma main contre elles, Et elles seront la proie de ceux qui leur étaient asservis. Et vous saurez que l''Eternel des armées m''a envoyé.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እጄን በላያቸው አወዛውዛለሁ፥ ተገዝተው ለነበሩት ብዝበዛ ይሆናሉ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ላከኝ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Pousse des cris d''allégresse et réjouis-toi, Fille de Sion! Car voici, je viens, et j''habiterai au milieu de toi, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ መጥቼ በመካከልሽ እኖራለሁና ዘምሪ ደስም ይበልሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de nations s''attacheront à l''Eternel en ce jour-là, Et deviendront mon peuple; J''habiterai au milieu de toi, Et tu sauras que l''Eternel des armées m''a envoyé vers toi.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ብዙ አሕዛብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጠጋሉ፥ ሕዝብም ይሆኑኛል፤ በመካከልሽም እኖራለሁ፥ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ወደ አንቺ እንደ ላከኝ ታውቂአለሽ።

verses.en: And the Lord shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
verses.fr: L''Eternel possédera Juda comme sa part Dans la terre sainte, Et il choisira encore Jérusalem.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይሁዳን እድል ፈንታው አድርጎ በተቀደሰችው ምድር ይወርሰዋል፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ዳግመኛ ይመርጣል።

verses.en: Be silent, O all flesh, before the Lord: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
verses.fr: Que toute chair fasse silence devant l''Eternel! Car il s''est réveillé de sa demeure sainte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከተቀደሰ ማደሪያው ነቅቶአልና ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ሆይ፥ በፊቱ ዝም በል።

verses.en: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
verses.fr: Il me fit voir Josué, le souverain sacrificateur, debout devant l''ange de l''Eternel, et Satan qui se tenait à sa droite pour l''accuser.
verses.am: እርሱም ታላቁን ካህን ኢያሱን በእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ፊት ቆሞ አሳየኝ፥ ሰይጣንም ይከስሰው ዘንድ በስተ ቀኙ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Satan, The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan; even the Lord that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Satan: Que l''Eternel te réprime, Satan! que l''Eternel te réprime, lui qui a choisi Jérusalem! N''est-ce pas là un tison arraché du feu?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። ሰይጣን ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይገሥጽህ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምን የመረጠ እግዚአብሔር ይገሥጽህ፤ በውኑ ይህ ከእሳት የተነጠቀ ትንታግ አይደለምን? አለው።

verses.en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
verses.fr: Or Josué était couvert de vêtements sales, et il se tenait debout devant l''ange.
verses.am: ኢያሱም እድፋም ልብስ ለብሶ በመልአኩ ፊት ቆሞ ነበር። እርሱም መልሶ በፊቱ የቆሙትን። እድፋሙን ልብስ ከእርሱ ላይ አውልቁ አላቸው። እርሱንም። እነሆ፥ አበሳህን ከአንተ አርቄአለሁ፥ ጥሩ ልብስም አለብስሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
verses.fr: L''ange, prenant la parole, dit à ceux qui étaient devant lui: Otez-lui les vêtements sales! Puis il dit à Josué: Vois, je t''enlève ton iniquité, et je te revêts d''habits de fête.
verses.am: ደግሞ። ንጹሕ ጥምጥም በራሱ ላይ አድርጉ አለ። እነርሱም በራሱ ላይ ንጹሕ ጥምጥም አደረጉ፥ ልብስንም አለበሱት፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በአጠገቡ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord stood by.
verses.fr: Je dis: Qu''on mette sur sa tête un turban pur! Et ils mirent un turban pur sur sa tête, et ils lui mirent des vêtements. L''ange de l''Eternel était là.
verses.am: ደግሞ። ንጹሕ ጥምጥም በራሱ ላይ አድርጉ አለ። እነርሱም በራሱ ላይ ንጹሕ ጥምጥም አደረጉ፥ ልብስንም አለበሱት፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በአጠገቡ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord protested unto Joshua, saying,
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel fit à Josué cette déclaration:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በኢያሱ እንዲህ ሲል አዳኘበት።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Si tu marches dans mes voies et si tu observes mes ordres, tu jugeras ma maison et tu garderas mes parvis, et je te donnerai libre accès parmi ceux qui sont ici.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በመንገዴ ብትሄድ ትእዛዜንም ብትጠብቅ፥ በቤቴ ላይ ትፈርዳለህ፥ አደባባዮቼንም ትጠብቃለህ፥ በዚህም ከቆሙት ከእነዚህ ጋር መግባትን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.
verses.fr: Ecoute donc, Josué, souverain sacrificateur, toi et tes compagnons qui sont assis devant toi! car ce sont des hommes qui serviront de signes. Voici, je ferai venir mon serviteur, le germe.
verses.am: ታላቁ ካህን ኢያሱ ሆይ፥ ስማ፤ በፊትህም የሚቀመጡት ባልንጀሮችህ ለምልክት የሚሆኑ ሰዎች ናቸውና ይስሙ፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ ባሪያዬን ቍጥቋጥ አወጣለሁ።

verses.en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.fr: Car voici, pour ce qui est de la pierre que j''ai placée devant Josué, il y a sept yeux sur cette seule pierre; voici, je graverai moi-même ce qui doit y être gravé, dit l''Eternel des armées; et j''enlèverai l''iniquité de ce pays, en un jour.
verses.am: በኢያሱ ፊት ያኖርሁት ድንጋይ እነሆ አለ፤ በአንዱ ድንጋይ ላይ ሰባት ዓይኖች አሉ፤ እነሆ፥ ቅርጹን እቀርጻለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ የዚያችንም ምድር በደል በአንድ ቀን አስወግዳለሁ።

verses.en: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel des armées, vous vous inviterez les uns les autres sous la vigne et sous le figuier.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ እያንዳንዱ ከወይኑና ከበለሱ በታች ሆኖ ባልንጀራውን ይጠራል።

verses.en: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.fr: L''ange qui parlait avec moi revint, et il me réveilla comme un homme que l''on réveille de son sommeil.
verses.am: ከእኔም ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረው መልአክ ተመልሶ ከእንቅልፉ እንደሚነቃ ሰው አነቃኝ።

verses.en: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
verses.fr: Il me dit: Que vois-tu? Je répondis: Je regarde, et voici, il y a un chandelier tout d''or, surmonté d''un vase et portant sept lampes, avec sept conduits pour les lampes qui sont au sommet du chandelier;
verses.am: እርሱም። የምታየው ምንድር ነው? አለኝ። እኔም። እነሆ፥ ሁለንተናው ወርቅ የሆነውን መቅረዝ አየሁ፤ የዘይትም ማሰሮ በራሱ ላይ ነበረ፥ ሰባትም መብራቶች ነበሩበት፤ በራሱም ላይ ለነበሩት መብራቶች ሰባት ቧንቧዎች ነበሩአቸው።

verses.en: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
verses.fr: et il y a près de lui deux oliviers, l''un à la droite du vase, et l''autre à sa gauche.
verses.am: ሁለት የወይራ ዛፎች፥ አንዱ በማሰሮው በስተ ቀኝ አንዱም በስተ ግራው ሆነው፥ በአጠገቡ ነበሩ አልሁ።

verses.en: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
verses.fr: Et reprenant la parole, je dis à l''ange qui parlait avec moi: Que signifient ces choses, mon seigneur?
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር ለነበረውም መልአክ መልሼ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ምንድር ናቸው? አልሁት።

verses.en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.fr: L''ange qui parlait avec moi me répondit: Ne sais-tu pas ce que signifient ces choses? Je dis: Non, mon seigneur.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረውም መልአክ መልሶ። እነዚህ ምን እንደ ሆኑ አታውቅምን? አለኝ። እኔም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ አላውቅም አልሁ።

verses.en: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Alors il reprit et me dit: C''est ici la parole que l''Eternel adresse à Zorobabel: Ce n''est ni par la puissance ni par la force, mais c''est par mon esprit, dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: መልሶም። ለዘሩባቤል የተባለው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው። በመንፈሴ እንጂ በኃይልና በብርታት አይደለም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
verses.fr: Qui es-tu, grande montagne, devant Zorobabel? Tu seras aplanie. Il posera la pierre principale au milieu des acclamations: Grâce, grâce pour elle!
verses.am: ታላቅ ተራራ ሆይ፥ አንተ ምንድር ነህ? በዘሩባቤል ፊት ደልዳላ ሜዳ ትሆናለህ፤ ሰዎችም። ሞገስ፥ ሞገስ ይሁንለት ብለው እየጮኹ እርሱ መደምደሚያውን ድንጋይ ያወጣል ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you.
verses.fr: Les mains de Zorobabel ont fondé cette maison, et ses mains l''achèveront; et tu sauras que l''Eternel des armées m''a envoyé vers vous.
verses.am: የዘሩባቤል እጆች ይህን ቤት መሠረቱ፥ የእርሱም እጆች ይፈጽሙታል፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ወደ እናንተ እንደ ላከኝ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
verses.fr: Car ceux qui méprisaient le jour des faibles commencements se réjouiront en voyant le niveau dans la main de Zorobabel. Ces sept sont les yeux de l''Eternel, qui parcourent toute la terre.
verses.am: የጥቂቱን ነገር ቀን የናቀ ማን ነው? እነዚህ ሰባቱ ደስ ብሎአቸው በዘሩባቤል እጅ ቱንቢውን ያያሉ፤ እነዚህም በምድር ሁሉ የሚዘዋወሩ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
verses.fr: Je pris la parole et je lui dis: Que signifient ces deux oliviers, à la droite du chandelier et à sa gauche?
verses.am: እኔም መልሼ። በመቅረዙ በስተ ቀኝና በስተ ግራ ያሉ እነዚህ ሁለት የወይራ ዛፎች ምንድር ናቸው? አልሁት።

verses.en: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
verses.fr: Je pris une seconde fois la parole, et je lui dis: Que signifient les deux rameaux d''olivier, qui sont près des deux conduits d''or d''où découle l''or?
verses.am: ሁለተኛም መልሼ። በሁለቱ የወርቅ ቧንቧዎች አጠገብ ሆነው የወርቁን ዘይት የሚያፈስሱ እነዚህ ሁለት የወይራ ቅርንጫፎች ምንድር ናቸው? አልሁት።

verses.en: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.fr: Il me répondit: Ne sais-tu pas ce qu''ils signifient? Je dis: Non, mon seigneur.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። እነዚህ ምን እንደ ሆኑ አታውቅምን? አለኝ። እኔም ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ አላውቅም አልሁት።

verses.en: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Ce sont les deux oints qui se tiennent devant le Seigneur de toute la terre.
verses.am: እርሱም። በምድር ሁሉ ጌታ አጠገብ የቆሙት ሁለቱ የተቀቡት እነዚህ ናቸው አለኝ።

verses.en: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
verses.fr: Je levai de nouveau les yeux et je regardai, et voici, il y avait un rouleau qui volait.
verses.am: ተመልሼም ዓይኖቼን አነሣሁ፥ እነሆም፥ አንድ በራሪ የመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል አየሁ።

verses.en: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
verses.fr: Il me dit: Que vois-tu? Je répondis: Je vois un rouleau qui vole; il a vingt coudées de longueur, et dix coudées de largeur.
verses.am: እርሱም። የምታየው ምንድር ነው? አለኝ። እኔም። በራሪ የመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል አያለሁ፤ ርዝመቱ ሀያ ክንድ ወርዱም አሥር ክንድ ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
verses.fr: Et il me dit: C''est la malédiction qui se répand sur tout le pays; car selon elle tout voleur sera chassé d''ici, et selon elle tout parjure sera chassé d''ici.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለኝ። ይህ በምድር ፊት ሁሉ ላይ የሚወጣው እርግማን ነው፤ የሚሰርቅ ሁሉ በእርሱ ላይ በዚህ በኩል እንደ ተጻፈው ሁሉ ይጠፋል፥ በሐሰት የሚምልም ሁሉ በእርሱ ላይ በዚያ በኩል እንደ ተጻፈው ሁሉ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
verses.fr: Je la répands, dit l''Eternel des armées, afin qu''elle entre dans la maison du voleur et de celui qui jure faussement en mon nom, afin qu''elle y établisse sa demeure, et qu''elle la consume avec le bois et les pierres.
verses.am: እኔ አስወጣዋለሁ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ ወደ ሚሰርቀውም ቤት፥ በሐሰትም በስሜ ወደሚምለው ቤት ይገባል፤ በቤቱም ውስጥ ይኖራል፥ እርሱንም፥ እንጨቱንና ድንጋዩን፥ ይበላል።

verses.en: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
verses.fr: L''ange qui parlait avec moi s''avança, et il me dit: Lève les yeux, et regarde ce qui sort là.
verses.am: ከእኔም ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረው መልአክ ወጥቶ። ዓይኖችህን አንሣ፥ ይህችም የምትወጣው ምን እንደ ሆነች እይ አለኝ።

verses.en: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
verses.fr: Je répondis: Qu''est-ce? Et il dit: C''est l''épha qui sort. Il ajouta: C''est leur iniquité dans tout le pays.
verses.am: እኔም። ምንድር ናት? አልሁ። እርሱም። ይህች የምትወጣው የኢፍ መስፈሪያ ናት አለኝ። ደግሞም። በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያለ በደላቸው ይህ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.
verses.fr: Et voici, une masse de plomb s''éleva, et il y avait une femme assise au milieu de l''épha.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የእርሳሱን መክሊት አነሡት፤ እነሆም፥ በኢፍ መስፈሪያው ውስጥ አንዲት ሴት ተቀምጣ ነበር።

verses.en: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
verses.fr: Il dit: C''est l''iniquité. Et il la repoussa dans l''épha, et il jeta sur l''ouverture la masse de plomb.
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህች ክፋት ናት አለኝ፤ በኢፍ መስፈሪያው ውስጥ ጣላት፥ የእርሳሱንም ጠገራ በመስፈሪያ አፍ ላይ ጣለ።

verses.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
verses.fr: Je levai les yeux et je regardai, et voici, deux femmes parurent. Le vent soufflait dans leurs ailes; elles avaient des ailes comme celles de la cigogne. Elles enlevèrent l''épha entre la terre et le ciel.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼንም አንሥቼ አየሁ፥ እነሆም፥ ሁለት ሴቶች ወጡ፥ ነፋስም በክንፎቻቸው ነበረ፤ ክንፎቻቸውም እንደ ሽመላ ክንፎች ነበሩ፤ የኢፍ መስፈሪያውንም በምድርና በሰማይ መካከል አነሡት።

verses.en: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
verses.fr: Je dis à l''ange qui parlait avec moi: Où emportent-elles l''épha?
verses.am: ከእኔም ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረውን መልአክ። እነዚህ የኢፍ መስፈሪያውን ወዴት ይወስዱታል? አልሁት።

verses.en: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
verses.fr: Il me répondit: Elles vont lui bâtir une maison dans le pays de Schinear; et quand elle sera prête, il sera déposé là dans son lieu.
verses.am: እርሱም። በሰናዖር ምድር ቤት ይሠሩለት ዘንድ ይወስዱታል፤ በተዘጋጀም ጊዜ በዚያ በስፍራው ይኖራል አለኝ።

verses.en: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
verses.fr: Je levai de nouveau les yeux et je regardai, et voici, quatre chars sortaient d''entre deux montagnes; et les montagnes étaient des montagnes d''airain.
verses.am: ተመልሼም ዓይኖቼን አነሣሁ፥ እነሆም፥ አራት ሰረገሎች ከሁለት ተራራ መካከል ሲወጡ አየሁ፤ ተራሮቹም የናስ ተራሮች ነበሩ።

verses.en: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
verses.fr: Au premier char il y avait des chevaux roux, au second char des chevaux noirs,
verses.am: በፊተኛው ሰረገላ መጋላ ፈረሶች፥ በሁለተኛውም ሰረገላ ዱሪ ፈረሶች ነበሩ፥

verses.en: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
verses.fr: au troisième char des chevaux blancs, et au quatrième char des chevaux tachetés, rouges.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ሰረገላ አምባላይ ፈረሶች፥ በአራተኛውም ሰረገላ ቅጥልጣል ፈረሶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
verses.fr: Je pris la parole et je dis à l''ange qui parlait avec moi: Qu''est-ce, mon seigneur?
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር ለነበረውም መልአክ መልሼ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እነዚህ ምንድር ናቸው? አልሁት።

verses.en: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.fr: L''ange me répondit: Ce sont les quatre vents des cieux, qui sortent du lieu où ils se tenaient devant le Seigneur de toute la terre.
verses.am: መልአኩም መልሶ። እነዚህ በምድር ሁሉ ጌታ ፊት ከቆሙበት ስፍራ የሚወጡ አራቱ የሰማይ ነፋሳት ናቸው።

verses.en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
verses.fr: Les chevaux noirs attelés à l''un des chars se dirigent vers le pays du septentrion, et les blancs vont après eux; les tachetés se dirigent vers le pays du midi.
verses.am: ዱሪ ፈረሶች ያሉበት ወደ ሰሜን ይወጣል፤ አምባላዮቹም ከእነርሱ በኋላ ይወጣሉ፥ ቅጥልጣሎችም ወደ ደቡብ ይወጣሉ አለኝ።

verses.en: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
verses.fr: Les rouges sortent et demandent à aller parcourir la terre. L''ange leur dit: Allez, parcourez la terre! Et ils parcoururent la terre.
verses.am: መጋላዎቹም ደግሞ ወጡ በምድርም ይመላለሱ ዘንድ ለመሄድ ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ እርሱም። ሂዱ፥ በምድር ላይ ተመላለሱ አለ። እነርሱም በምድር ላይ ተመላለሱ።

verses.en: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
verses.fr: Il m''appela, et il me dit: Vois, ceux qui se dirigent vers le pays du septentrion font reposer ma colère sur le pays du septentrion.
verses.am: ጮኾም። እነሆ፥ ወደ ሰሜን ምድር የሚወጡት እነርሱ መንፈሴን በሰሜን ምድር ላይ አሳርፈዋል ብሎ ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
verses.fr: Tu recevras les dons des captifs, Heldaï, Tobija et Jedaeja, et tu iras toi-même ce jour-là, tu iras dans la maison de Josias, fils de Sophonie, où ils se sont rendus en arrivant de Babylone.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን ከመጡት ምርኮኞች ከሔልዳይና ከጦብያ ከዮዳኤም ውሰድ፤ በዚያም ቀን መጥተህ ወደ ሶፎንያስ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮስያስ ቤት ግባ።

verses.en: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
verses.fr: Tu prendras de l''argent et de l''or, et tu en feras des couronnes, que tu mettras sur la tête de Josué, fils de Jotsadak, le souverain sacrificateur.
verses.am: ብርንና ወርቅን ከእነርሱ ውሰድ፥ አክሊሎችንም ሥራ፤ በታላቁም ካህን በኢዮሴዴቅ ልጅ በኢያሱ ራስ ላይ ድፋቸው፥

verses.en: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The Branch; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord:
verses.fr: Tu lui diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Voici, un homme, dont le nom est germe, germera dans son lieu, et bâtira le temple de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንዲህም በለው። የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ስሙ ቍጥቋጥ የሚባል ሰው በስፍራው ይበቅላል፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም መቅደስ ይሠራል።

verses.en: Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
verses.fr: Il bâtira le temple de l''Eternel; il portera les insignes de la majesté; il s''assiéra et dominera sur son trône, il sera sacrificateur sur son trône, et une parfaite union régnera entre l''un et l''autre.
verses.am: እርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ ይሠራል፥ ክብርንም ይሸከማል፥ በዙፋኑም ላይ ተቀምጦ ይነግሣል፤ በዙፋኑም ላይ ካህን ይሆናል፥ የሰላምም ምክር በሁለቱ መካከል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les couronnes seront pour Hélem, Tobija et Jedaeja, et pour Hen, fils de Sophonie, un souvenir dans le temple de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አክሊሎችም ለሔሌምና ለጦብያ ለዮዳኤም ለሶፎንያስም ልጅ ለሔን በእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ውስጥ ለመታሰቢያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the Lord, and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont éloignés viendront et travailleront au temple de l''Eternel; et vous saurez que l''Eternel des armées m''a envoyé vers vous. Cela arrivera, si vous écoutez la voix de l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: በሩቅም ያሉት መጥተው የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ ይሠራሉ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ወደ እናንተ እንደ ላከኝ ታውቃላችሁ። የአምላካችሁንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አጥብቃችሁ ብትሰሙ ይህ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
verses.fr: La quatrième année du roi Darius, la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Zacharie, le quatrième jour du neuvième mois, qui est le mois de Kisleu.
verses.am: በንጉሡም በዳርዮስ በአራተኛው ዓመት ካሴሉ በሚባል በዘጠነኛው ወር በአራተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ዘካርያስ መጣ።

verses.en: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the Lord,
verses.fr: On avait envoyé de Béthel Scharetser et Réguem-Mélec avec ses gens pour implorer l''Eternel,
verses.am: የቤቴልም ሰዎች ሳራሳርንና ሬጌሜሌክን ሰዎቻቸውንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይለምኑ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the Lord of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
verses.fr: et pour dire aux sacrificateurs de la maison de l''Eternel des armées et aux prophètes: Faut-il que je pleure au cinquième mois et que je fasse abstinence, comme je l''ai fait tant d''années?
verses.am: ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ካህናት ለነቢያትም። ባለፉት ዓመታት እንዳደረግሁት በአምስተኛው ወር መለየትና ማልቀስ ይገባኛልን? ብለው ይናገሩ ዘንድ ልኮአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Then came the word of the Lord of hosts unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel des armées me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የሠራዊትም ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
verses.fr: Dis à tout le peuple du pays et aux sacrificateurs: Quand vous avez jeûné et pleuré au cinquième et au septième mois, et cela depuis soixante-dix ans, est-ce pour moi que vous avez jeûné?
verses.am: ለምድሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ለካህናትም እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። በዚህ በሰባው ዓመት በአምስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ወር በጾማችሁና ባለቀሳችሁ ጊዜ፥ በውኑ ለእኔ ጾም ጾማችሁልኝ?

verses.en: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
verses.fr: Et quand vous mangez et buvez, n''est-ce pas vous qui mangez et vous qui buvez?
verses.am: በምትበሉበትና በምትጠጡበትስ ጊዜ፥ ለራሳችሁ የምትበሉና የምትጠጡ አይደላችሁምን?

verses.en: Should ye not hear the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
verses.fr: Ne connaissez-vous pas les paroles qu''a proclamées l''Eternel par les premiers prophètes, lorsque Jérusalem était habitée et tranquille avec ses villes à l''entour, et que le midi et la plaine étaient habités?
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌምና በዙሪያዋ ያሉ ከተሞች ገና ሰዎች ባሉባቸው ጊዜ፥ በምቾትም ተቀምጠው ሳሉ፥ ደቡቡና ቈላውም ሰዎች ባሉባቸው ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር በቀደሙት ነቢያት እጅ የተናገረውን ቃል መስማት አይገባችሁምን?

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Zacharie, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ዘካርያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
verses.fr: Ainsi parlait l''Eternel des armées: Rendez véritablement la justice, Et ayez l''un pour l''autre de la bonté et de la miséricorde.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ተናግሮአል። እውነተኛውን ፍርድ ፍረዱ፤ ቸርነትንና ምሕረትን ሁላችሁ ለወንድሞቻችሁ አድርጉ፤

verses.en: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
verses.fr: N''opprimez pas la veuve et l''orphelin, l''étranger et le pauvre, Et ne méditez pas l''un contre l''autre le mal dans vos coeurs.
verses.am: መበለቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን፥ መጻተኛውንና ችግረኛውን አትበድሉ፤ ከእናንተም ማንም በወንድሙ ላይ ክፉውን ነገር በልቡ አያስብ።

verses.en: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
verses.fr: Mais ils refusèrent d''être attentifs, ils eurent l''épaule rebelle, et ils endurcirent leurs oreilles pour ne pas entendre.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ደንደሳቸውን አዞሩ እንጂ መስማትን እምቢ አሉ፤ እንዳይሰሙም ጆሮአቸውን አደነቈሩ።

verses.en: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the Lord of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Ils rendirent leur coeur dur comme le diamant, pour ne pas écouter la loi et les paroles que l''Eternel des armées leur adressait par son esprit, par les premiers prophètes. Ainsi l''Eternel des armées s''enflamma d''une grande colère.
verses.am: የሠራዊትም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በቀደሙት ነቢያት እጅ በመንፈሱ የላከውን ሕጉንና ቃሉን እንዳይሰሙ ልባቸውን እንደ አልማዝ አጠነከሩ፤ ስለዚህ ከሠራዊት ጌታ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ታላቅ ቍጣ መጣ።

verses.en: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the Lord of hosts:
verses.fr: Quand il appelait, ils n''ont pas écouté: aussi n''ai-je pas écouté, quand ils ont appelé, dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: እኔ በጠራሁ ጊዜ እነርሱ እንዳልሰሙኝ፥ እንዲሁ እነርሱ በሚጠሩበት ጊዜ እኔ አልሰማም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
verses.fr: Je les ai dispersés parmi toutes les nations qu''ils ne connaissaient pas; le pays a été dévasté derrière eux, il n''y a plus eu ni allants ni venants; et d''un pays de délices ils ont fait un désert.
verses.am: ወደማያውቁአቸውም አሕዛብ ሁሉ በዐውሎ ነፋስ በተንኋቸው። እንዲሁ ከእነርሱ በኋላ ምድሪቱ ባድማ ሆናለች፥ የሚተላለፍባትና የሚመላለስባትም አልነበረም፤ ያማረችውንም ምድር ባድማ አደረጉአት።

verses.en: Again the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel des armées se révéla, en ces mots:
verses.am: የሠራዊትም ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Je suis ému pour Sion d''une grande jalousie, et je suis saisi pour elle d''une grande fureur.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ጽዮን ታላቅ ቅንዓት ቀንቻለሁ፥ በታላቅም ቍጣ ስለ እርስዋ ቀንቻለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the Lord of hosts the holy mountain.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Je retourne à Sion, et je veux habiter au milieu de Jérusalem. Jérusalem sera appelée ville fidèle, et la montagne de l''Eternel des armées montagne sainte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ ጽዮን ተመልሻለሁ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም መካከል እኖራለሁ፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም የእውነት ከተማ ትባላለች፤ የሠራዊትም ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ተራራ የተቀደሰ ተራራ ይባላል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Des vieillards et des femmes âgées s''assiéront encore dans les rues de Jérusalem, chacun le bâton à la main, à cause du grand nombre de leurs jours.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ዳግመኛ ሽማግሌዎችና ባልቴቶች በኢየሩሳሌም አደባባይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ ሰውም ሁሉ ከዕድሜው ብዛት የተነሣ ምርኩዝ በእጁ ይይዛል።

verses.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
verses.fr: Les rues de la ville seront remplies de jeunes garçons et de jeunes filles, jouant dans les rues.
verses.am: የከተማይቱም አደባባዮች በእነዚያ በሚጫወቱ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች ይሞላሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Si la chose paraît étonnante aux yeux du reste de ce peuple en ces jours-là, sera-t-elle de même étonnante à mes yeux? dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚህ ወራት በዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ዓይን ዘንድ ድንቅ ቢሆን፥ በውኑ በእኔ ዓይን ዘንድ ደግሞ ድንቅ ይሆናልን? ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Voici, je délivre mon peuple du pays de l''orient et du pays du soleil couchant.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ሕዝቤን ከምሥራቅ ምድርና ከምዕራብ ምድር አድነዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
verses.fr: Je les ramènerai, et ils habiteront au milieu de Jérusalem; ils seront mon peuple, et je serai leur Dieu avec vérité et droiture.
verses.am: አመጣቸዋለሁም፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ውስጥ ይኖራሉ፤ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑኛል፥ እኔም በእውነትና በጽድቅ አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the Lord of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Fortifiez vos mains, vous qui entendez aujourd''hui ces paroles de la bouche des prophètes qui parurent au temps où fut fondée la maison de l''Eternel des armées, où le temple allait être bâti.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። መቅደሱ ይሠራ ዘንድ የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ከተመሠረተበት ቀን ጀምሮ ከነቢያት አፍ ይህን ቃል በዚህ ዘመን የሰማችሁ እናንተ ሆይ፥ እጃችሁን አበርቱ።

verses.en: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
verses.fr: Car avant ce temps, le travail de l''homme ne recevait pas sa récompense, et le salaire des bêtes était nul; il n''y avait point de paix pour ceux qui entraient et sortaient, à cause de l''ennemi, et je lâchais tous les hommes les uns contre les autres.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወራት አስቀድሞ ለሰውና ለእንስሳ ዋጋ አልነበረምና፤ እኔም ሰውን ሁሉ በወንድሙ ላይ አስነሥቼ ነበርና ከአስጨናቂው የተነሣ ለሚገባውና ለሚወጣው ሰላም አልነበረም።

verses.en: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.fr: Maintenant je ne suis pas pour le reste de ce peuple comme j''étais dans le temps passé, dit l''Eternel des armées.
verses.am: አሁን ግን እንደ ቀደመው ዘመን በዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ላይ አልሆንም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
verses.fr: Car les semailles prospéreront, la vigne rendra son fruit, la terre donnera ses produits, et les cieux enverront leur rosée; je ferai jouir de toutes ces choses le reste de ce peuple.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰላምን እዘራለሁ፤ ወይኑ ፍሬውን ይሰጣል፥ ምድርም አዝመራዋን ታወጣለች፥ ሰማያትም ጠላቸውን ይሰጣሉ፤ ለዚህም ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ አወርሳለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
verses.fr: De même que vous avez été en malédiction parmi les nations, maison de Juda et maison d''Israël, de même je vous sauverai, et vous serez en bénédiction. Ne craignez pas, et que vos mains se fortifient!
verses.am: የይሁዳ ቤትና የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ እርግማን እንደ ነበራችሁ፥ እንዲሁ አድናችኋለሁ፥ በረከትም ትሆናላችሁ፤ አትፍሩ፥ እጃችሁንም አበርቱ።

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the Lord of hosts, and I repented not:
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Comme j''ai eu la pensée de vous faire du mal lorsque vos pères m''irritaient, dit l''Eternel des armées, et que je ne m''en suis point repenti,
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አባቶቻችሁ እጅግ ባስቈጡኝ ጊዜ ክፉ ለማድረግ እንዳሰብሁ፥ እንዳልተጸጸትሁም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥

verses.en: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
verses.fr: ainsi je reviens en arrière et j''ai résolu en ces jours de faire du bien à Jérusalem et à la maison de Juda. Ne craignez pas!
verses.am: እንዲሁ ዳግመኛ ለኢየሩሳሌምና ለይሁዳ ቤት በዚህ ወራት በጎነትን አደርግ ዘንድ አስቤአለሁ፤ አትፍሩ።

verses.en: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
verses.fr: Voici ce que vous devez faire: dites la vérité chacun à son prochain; jugez dans vos portes selon la vérité et en vue de la paix;
verses.am: የምትሠሩት ነገር ይህ ነው፤ እያንዳንዳችሁ ከባልንጀራችሁ ጋር እውነትን ተነጋገሩ፤ በበር አደባባያችሁም የእውነትንና የሰላምን ፍርድ ፍረዱ፤

verses.en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: que nul en son coeur ne pense le mal contre son prochain, et n''aimez pas le faux serment, car ce sont là toutes choses que je hais, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሁላችሁም በባልንጀራችሁ ላይ ክፉን ነገር በልባችሁ አታስቡ፤ የሐሰትንም መሐላ አትውደዱ፤ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ እጠላለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord of hosts came unto me, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel des armées me fut adressée, en ces mots:
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Le jeûne du quatrième mois, le jeûne du cinquième, le jeûne du septième et le jeûne du dixième se changeront pour la maison de Juda en jours d''allégresse et de joie, en fêtes de réjouissance. Mais aimez la vérité et la paix.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአራተኛው ወር ጾም የአምስተኛውም የሰባተኛውም የአሥረኛውም ወር ጾም ለይሁዳ ቤት ደስታና ተድላ የሐሤትም በዓላት ይሆናል፤ ስለዚህም እውነትንና ሰላምን ውደዱ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: Il viendra encore des peuples et des habitants d''un grand nombre de villes.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በብዙ ከተሞች የሚቀመጡ አሕዛብ ገና ይመጣሉ፤

verses.en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the Lord, and to seek the Lord of hosts: I will go also.
verses.fr: Les habitants d''une ville iront à l''autre, en disant: Allons implorer l''Eternel et chercher l''Eternel des armées! Nous irons aussi!
verses.am: በአንዲትም ከተማ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች። እግዚአብሔርን እንለምን ዘንድ፥ የሠራዊትንም ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን እንፈልግ ዘንድ ኑ እንሂድ፤ እኔም እሄዳለሁ እያሉ ወደ ሌላ ከተማ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the Lord.
verses.fr: Et beaucoup de peuples et de nombreuses nations viendront chercher l''Eternel des armées à Jérusalem et implorer l''Eternel.
verses.am: ብዙ ወገኖችና ኃይለኞች አሕዛብ በኢየሩሳሌም የሠራዊትን ጌታ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ይለምኑ ዘንድ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel des armées: En ces jours-là, dix hommes de toutes les langues des nations saisiront un Juif par le pan de son vêtement et diront: Nous irons avec vous, car nous avons appris que Dieu est avec vous.
verses.am: የሠራዊትም ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በዚያ ዘመን ከአሕዛብ ቋንቋ ሁሉ አሥር ሰዎች የአንዱን አይሁዳዊ ሰው ልብስ ዘርፍ ይዘው። እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር እንዳለ ሰምተናልና ከእናንተ ጋር እንሂድ ይላሉ።

verses.en: The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord.
verses.fr: Oracle, parole de l''Eternel sur le pays de Hadrac. Elle s''arrête sur Damas, Car l''Eternel a l''oeil sur les hommes Comme sur toutes les tribus d''Israël;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሸክም በሴድራክ ምድር ላይ ነው፥ በደማስቆም ላይ ያርፋል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ወደ ሰውና ወደ እስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ዘንድ ነው፤

verses.en: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
verses.fr: Elle s''arrête aussi sur Hamath, à la frontière de Damas, Sur Tyr et Sidon, malgré toute leur sagesse.
verses.am: ደግሞም በዳርቻዋ ባለችው በሐማት ላይ፥ እጅግ ጠቢበኞች በሆኑ በጢሮስና በሲዶና ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.fr: Tyr s''est bâti une forteresse; Elle a amassé l''argent comme la poussière, Et l''or comme la boue des rues.
verses.am: ጢሮስም ምሽግን ለራስዋ ሠርታለች፥ ብሩንም እንደ አፈር ጥሩውንም ወርቅ እንደ መንገድ ጭቃ አከማችታለች።

verses.en: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
verses.fr: Voici, le Seigneur s''en emparera, Il précipitera sa puissance dans la mer, Et elle sera consumée par le feu.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጌታ ይገፍፋታል፥ በባሕርም ላይ ያለውን ብርታትዋን ይመታል፤ እርስዋም በእሳት ትበላለች።

verses.en: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.fr: Askalon le verra, et elle sera dans la crainte; Gaza aussi, et un violent tremblement la saisira; Ekron aussi, car son espoir sera confondu. Le roi disparaîtra de Gaza, Et Askalon ne sera plus habitée.
verses.am: አስቀሎና አይታ ትፈራለች፤ ጋዛ ደግሞ አይታ እጅግ ትታመማለች፤ አቃሮንም እንዲሁ፥ ተስፋዋ ይቈረጣልና፤ ንጉሡም ከጋዛ ይጠፋል፥ በአስቀሎናም የሚቀመጥ አይገኝም።

verses.en: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.fr: L''étranger s''établira dans Asdod, Et j''abattrai l''orgueil des Philistins.
verses.am: የተደባለቀ ወገን በአዛጦን ይቀመጣል፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ትዕቢት አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.fr: J''ôterai le sang de sa bouche, Et les abominations d''entre ses dents; Lui aussi restera pour notre Dieu; Il sera comme un chef en Juda, Et Ekron sera comme les Jébusiens.
verses.am: ደሙንም ከአፉ ውስጥ ርኩሱንም ነገር ከጥርሱ መካከል አስወግዳለሁ፤ እርሱም ደግሞ ለአምላካችን ቅሬታ ይሆናል፤ በይሁዳም እንደ አለቃ ይሆናል፥ አቃሮንም እንደ ኢያቡሳዊ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
verses.fr: Je camperai autour de ma maison pour la défendre contre une armée, Contre les allants et les venants, Et l''oppresseur ne passera plus près d''eux; Car maintenant mes yeux sont fixés sur elle.
verses.am: እኔም ማንም እንዳይሄድና እንዳይመለስ እንደ ጠባቂ ጦር ሆኖ በቤቴ ዙሪያ ሰፈር አደርጋለሁ፤ አሁንም በዓይኔ አይቻለሁና ከዚህ በኋላ አስጨናቂ አያልፍባቸውም።

verses.en: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.fr: Sois transportée d''allégresse, fille de Sion! Pousse des cris de joie, fille de Jérusalem! Voici, ton roi vient à toi; Il est juste et victorieux, Il est humble et monté sur un âne, Sur un âne, le petit d''une ânesse.
verses.am: አንቺ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እጅግ ደስ ይበልሽ፤ አንቺ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጅ ሆይ፥ እልል በዪ፤ እነሆ፥ ንጉሥሽ ጻድቅና አዳኝ ነው፤ ትሑትም ሆኖ በአህያም፥ በአህያይቱ ግልገል በውርጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል።

verses.en: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
verses.fr: Je détruirai les chars d''Ephraïm, Et les chevaux de Jérusalem; Et les arcs de guerre seront anéantis. Il annoncera la paix aux nations, Et il dominera d''une mer à l''autre, Depuis le fleuve jusqu''aux extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: ሰረገላውንም ከኤፍሬም ፈረሱንም ከኢየሩሳሌም አጠፋለሁ፤ የሰልፉም ቀስት ይሰበራል፥ ለአሕዛብም ሰላምን ይናገራል፤ ግዛቱም ከባሕር እስከ ባሕር፥ ከወንዙም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድርስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
verses.fr: Et pour toi, à cause de ton alliance scellée par le sang, Je retirerai tes captifs de la fosse où il n''y a pas d''eau.
verses.am: ለአንቺም ደግሞ ስለ ቃል ኪዳንሽ ደም፥ እስሮችሽን ውኃ ከሌለበት ጕድጓድ አውጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
verses.fr: Retournez à la forteresse, captifs pleins d''espérance! Aujourd''hui encore je le déclare, Je te rendrai le double.
verses.am: እናንተ በተስፋ የምትኖሩ እስሮች ሆይ፥ ወደ ጽኑ አምባ ተመለሱ፤ ሁለት እጥፍ አድርጌ እንድመልስልሽ ዛሬ እነግርሻለሁ።

verses.en: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
verses.fr: Car je bande Juda comme un arc, Je m''arme d''Ephraïm comme d''un arc, Et je soulèverai tes enfants, ô Sion, Contre tes enfants, ô Javan! Je te rendrai pareille à l''épée d''un vaillant homme.
verses.am: ይሁዳን ለእኔ ገትሬአለሁ፤ ቀስቱን በኤፍሬም ሞልቼአለሁ፤ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ልጆችሽን በግሪክ ልጆች ላይ አስነሣለሁ፥ አንቺንም እንደ ኃያል ሰው ሰይፍ አደርግሻለሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.fr: L''Eternel au-dessus d''eux apparaîtra, Et sa flèche partira comme l''éclair; Le Seigneur, l''Eternel, sonnera de la trompette, Il s''avancera dans l''ouragan du midi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ ይገለጣል፥ ፍላጻውም እንደ መብረቅ ይወጣል፤ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም መለከትን ይነፋል፥ በደቡብም ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
verses.fr: L''Eternel des armées les protégera; Ils dévoreront, ils vaincront les pierres de la fronde; Ils boiront, ils seront bruyants comme pris de vin; Ils seront pleins comme une coupe, Comme les coins de l''autel.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቃቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ይበሉአቸዋል፥ የወንጭፉንም ድንጋዮች ይረግጣሉ፤ እንደ ወይን ጠጅም ይጠጡአቸዋል፥ እንደ ጥዋዎችም እንደ መሠዊያም ማዕዘኖች የተሞሉ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, leur Dieu, les sauvera en ce jour-là, Comme le troupeau de son peuple; Car ils sont les pierres d''un diadème, Qui brilleront dans son pays.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሕዝቡ መንጋ ያድናቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ለአክሊል እንደሚሆኑ እንደ ከበሩ ድንጋዮች ይሆናሉ፥ በምድሩም ላይ ይብለጨለጫሉ።

verses.en: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
verses.fr: Oh! quelle prospérité pour eux! quelle beauté! Le froment fera croître les jeunes hommes, Et le moût les jeunes filles.
verses.am: በጎነቱ እንዴት ታላቅ ነው! ውበቱስ እንዴት ታላቅ ነው! እህል ጐበዛዝቱን፥ ጉሽ ጠጅም ቈነጃጅቱን ያለመልማል።

verses.en: Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
verses.fr: Demandez à l''Eternel la pluie, la pluie du printemps! L''Eternel produira des éclairs, Et il vous enverra une abondante pluie, Il donnera à chacun de l''herbe dans son champ.
verses.am: በኋለኛው ዝናብ ጊዜ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ዝናቡን ለምኑ፤ እግዚአብሔር መብረቅ ያደርጋል፤ እርሱም የበልግ ዝናብን ለእያንዳንዱም በሜዳ ውስጥ ሣርን ይሰጣል።

verses.en: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
verses.fr: Car les théraphim ont des paroles de néant, Les devins prophétisent des faussetés, Les songes mentent et consolent par la vanité. C''est pourquoi ils sont errants comme un troupeau, Ils sont malheureux parce qu''il n''y a point de pasteur.
verses.am: ተራፊም ከንቱነትን ተናግረዋልና፥ ምዋርተኞችም ውሸትን አይተዋልና፤ ሕልምንም የሚያዩ በሐሰት ተናግረዋል፥ በከንቱም ያጽናናሉ፤ እረኛም የላቸውምና እንደ በጎች ተቅበዝብዘዋል ተጨንቀውማል።

verses.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the Lord of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
verses.fr: Ma colère s''est enflammée contre les pasteurs, Et je châtierai les boucs; Car l''Eternel des armées visite son troupeau, la maison de Juda, Et il en fera comme son cheval de gloire dans la bataille;
verses.am: ቍጣዬ በእረኞች ላይ ነድዶአል፥ አውራ ፍየሎችንም እቀጣለሁ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም የይሁዳን ቤት መንጋውን ጐብኝቶአል፥ በሰልፍም ውስጥ እንዳለ እንደ ክብሩ ፈረስ ያደርጋቸዋል።

verses.en: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
verses.fr: De lui sortira l''angle, de lui le clou, de lui l''arc de guerre; De lui sortiront tous les chefs ensemble.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ዘንድ የማዕዘኑ ድንጋይ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ ችንካሩ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ የሰልፉ ቀስት፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ አስገባሪው ሁሉ በአንድ ላይ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the Lord is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.fr: Ils seront comme des héros foulant dans la bataille la boue des rues; Ils combattront, parce que l''Eternel sera avec eux; Et ceux qui seront montés sur des chevaux seront couverts de honte.
verses.am: በሰልፍም ጊዜ ጠላቶቻቸውን በመንገድ ጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረግጡ ኃያላን ይሆናሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነውና ይዋጋሉ፥ ፈረሰኞችም ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the Lord their God, and will hear them.
verses.fr: Je fortifierai la maison de Juda, Et je délivrerai la maison de Joseph; Je les ramènerai, car j''ai compassion d''eux, Et ils seront comme si je ne les avais pas rejetés; Car je suis l''Eternel, leur Dieu, et je les exaucerai.
verses.am: ወድጃቸዋለሁና የይሁዳን ቤት አበረታለሁ፥ የዮሴፍንም ቤት አድናለሁ፤ አደላድላቸዋለሁም፤ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር ነኝና፥ እኔም እሰማቸዋለሁና እንዳልጣልኋቸው ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.
verses.fr: Ephraïm sera comme un héros; Leur coeur aura la joie que donne le vin; Leurs fils le verront et seront dans l''allégresse, Leur coeur se réjouira en l''Eternel.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ሰዎች እንደ ኃያላን ይሆናሉ፥ ልባቸውም የወይን ጠጅ እንደ ጠጣ ሰው ደስ ይለዋል፤ ልጆቻቸውም አይተው ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ ልባቸውም በእግዚአብሔር ሐሤት ያደርጋል።

verses.en: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.fr: Je les sifflerai et les rassemblerai, car je les rachète, Et ils multiplieront comme ils multipliaient.
verses.am: ተቤዥቼአቸዋለሁና በፉጨት ጠርቼ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ቀድሞም በዝተው እንደ ነበሩ ይበዛሉ።

verses.en: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
verses.fr: Je les disperserai parmi les peuples, Et au loin ils se souviendront de moi; Ils vivront avec leurs enfants, et ils reviendront.
verses.am: በአሕዛብም መካከል ብዘራቸው እንኳ በሩቅ አገር ሳሉ ያስቡኛል፥ ከልጆቻቸውም ጋር በሕይወት ይኖራሉ፥ ይመለሱማል።

verses.en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
verses.fr: Je les ramènerai du pays d''Egypte, Et je les rassemblerai de l''Assyrie; Je les ferai venir au pays de Galaad et au Liban, Et l''espace ne leur suffira pas.
verses.am: ከግብጽም ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ ከአሦርም እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ወደ ገለዓድና ወደ ሊባኖስ ምድር አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ የሚበቃም ቦታ አይገኝላቸውም።

verses.en: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
verses.fr: Il passera la mer de détresse, il frappera les flots de la mer, Et toutes les profondeurs du fleuve seront desséchées; L''orgueil de l''Assyrie sera abattu, Et le sceptre de l''Egypte disparaîtra.
verses.am: እርሱም በጭንቅ ባሕር ያልፋል፥ የባሕርንም ሞገድ ይመታል፥ የወንዙም ጥልቅ ሁሉ ይደርቃል፤ የአሦርም ትዕቢት ይዋረዳል፥ የግብጽም በትረ መንግሥት ይርቃል።

verses.en: And I will strengthen them in the Lord; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je les fortifierai par l''Eternel, Et ils marcheront en son nom, Dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: በአምላካቸው በእግዚአብሔር አበረታቸዋለሁ፥ በስሙም ይመካሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
verses.fr: Liban, ouvre tes portes, Et que le feu dévore tes cèdres!
verses.am: ሊባኖስ ሆይ፥ ደጆችህን ክፈት፥ እሳትም ዝግባዎችህን ትብላ።

verses.en: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
verses.fr: Gémis, cyprès, car le cèdre est tombé, Ceux qui s''élevaient sont détruits! Gémissez, chênes de Basan, Car la forêt inaccessible est renversée!
verses.am: የጥድ ዛፍ ሆይ፥ ዝግባ ወድቆአልና፥ ከበርቴዎችም ጠፍተዋልና ዋይ በል፤ እናንተም የባሳን ዛፎች ሆይ፥ ጽኑው ጫካ ተቈርጦአልና ዋይ በሉ።

verses.en: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
verses.fr: Les bergers poussent des cris lamentables, Parce que leur magnificence est détruite; Les lionceaux rugissent, Parce que l''orgueil du Jourdain est abattu.
verses.am: የእረኞች ክብር ተዋርዶአልና የዋይታቸው ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል፤ የዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ተዋርዶአልና የአንበሶች ግሣት ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, mon Dieu: Pais les brebis destinées à la boucherie!
verses.am: አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎአል። ለእርድ የሚሆኑትን በጎች ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
verses.fr: Ceux qui les achètent les égorgent impunément; Celui qui les vend dit: Béni soit l''Eternel, car je m''enrichis! Et leurs pasteurs ne les épargnent pas.
verses.am: የገዙአቸው ያርዱአቸዋል፥ ራሳቸውንም እንደ በደለኞች አድርገው አይቈጥሩም፤ የሸጡአቸውም። ባለ ጠጋ ሆነናልና እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን ይላሉ፤ እረኞቻቸውም አይራሩላቸውም።

verses.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
verses.fr: Car je n''ai plus de pitié pour les habitants du pays, Dit l''Eternel; Et voici, je livre les hommes Aux mains les uns des autres et aux mains de leur roi; Ils ravageront le pays, Et je ne délivrerai pas de leurs mains.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በምድር ላይ ለሚኖሩ አልራራም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እነሆም፥ ሰውን ሁሉ በባልንጀራውና በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ ምድሪቱንም ይመታሉ፥ ከእጃቸውም አላድናቸውም።

verses.en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
verses.fr: Alors je me mis à paître les brebis destinées à la boucherie, assurément les plus misérables du troupeau. Je pris deux houlettes: j''appelai l''une Grâce, et j''appelai l''autre Union. Et je fis paître les brebis.
verses.am: እኔም ለእርድ የሚሆኑትን በጎች፥ የመንጋውን ችግረኞች ጠበቅሁ። ሁለት በትሮችንም ወሰድሁ፤ የአንዲቱን ስም ውበት የሁለተኛይቱንም ስም ማሰሪያ ብዬ ጠራሁ፤ መንጋውንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
verses.fr: J''exterminai les trois pasteurs en un mois; mon âme était impatiente à leur sujet, et leur âme avait aussi pour moi du dégoût.
verses.am: በአንድ ወርም ሦስቱን እረኞች አጠፋሁ፤ ነፍሴም ተሰቀቀቻቸው፥ ነፍሳቸውም ደግሞ እኔን ጠላች።

verses.en: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
verses.fr: Et je dis: Je ne vous paîtrai plus! Que celle qui va mourir meure, que celle qui va périr périsse, et que celles qui restent se dévorent les unes les autres!
verses.am: እኔም። እናንተን አልጠብቅም፤ የሚሞተው ይሙት፥ የሚጠፋውም ይጥፋ፤ የቀረውም እያንዳንዱ የባልንጀራውን ሥጋ ይብላ አልሁ።

verses.en: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
verses.fr: Je pris ma houlette Grâce, et je la brisai, pour rompre mon alliance que j''avais traitée avec tous les peuples.
verses.am: እኔም ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ ጋር የገባሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አፈርስ ዘንድ ውበት የተባለችውን በትሬን ወስጄ ቈረጥሁ።

verses.en: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Elle fut rompue ce jour-là; et les malheureuses brebis, qui prirent garde à moi, reconnurent ainsi que c''était la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ተሰበረች፤ እንዲሁም እኔን የተመለከቱ የመንጋው ችግረኞች የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ነበረ አወቁ።

verses.en: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
verses.fr: Je leur dis: Si vous le trouvez bon, donnez-moi mon salaire; sinon, ne le donnez pas. Et ils pesèrent pour mon salaire trente sicles d''argent.
verses.am: እኔም። ደስ ብሎአችሁ እንደ ሆነ ዋጋዬን ስጡኝ፤ ያለዚያ ግን ተዉት አልሁ። እነርሱም ለዋጋዬ ሠላሳ ብር መዘኑ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Jette-le au potier, ce prix magnifique auquel ils m''ont estimé! Et je pris les trente sicles d''argent, et je les jetai dans la maison de l''Eternel, pour le potier.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። የተስማሙበትን የከበረውን ዋጋዬን በግምጃ ቤቱ ውስጥ አኑረው አለኝ። እኔም ሠላሳውን ብር ወስጄ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ባለው በግምጃ ቤቱ ውስጥ አኖርሁት።

verses.en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
verses.fr: Puis je brisai ma seconde houlette Union, pour rompre la fraternité entre Juda et Israël.
verses.am: በይሁዳና በእስራኤል መካከል ያለውንም ወንድማማችነት እሰብር ዘንድ ማሰሪያ የተባለችውን ሁለተኛይቱን በትሬን ቈረጥሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Prends encore l''équipage d''un pasteur insensé!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አለኝ። ዳግመኛም የሰነፍን እረኛ ዕቃ ውሰድ።

verses.en: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
verses.fr: Car voici, je susciterai dans le pays un pasteur qui n''aura pas souci des brebis qui périssent; il n''ira pas à la recherche des plus jeunes, il ne guérira pas les blessées, il ne soignera pas les saines; mais il dévorera la chair des plus grasses, et il déchirera jusqu''aux cornes de leurs pieds.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአገሩ ውስጥ እረኛ አስነሣለሁ፤ እርሱም የጠፋውን አያስብም፥ የባዘነውን አይፈልግም፥ የተሰበረውን አይጠግንም፤ የዳነውንም አይቀልብም፥ ነገር ግን የሰባውን ሥጋ ይበላል፥ ሰኰናውንም ይቀለጣጥማል።

verses.en: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
verses.fr: Malheur au pasteur de néant, qui abandonne ses brebis! Que l''épée fonde sur son bras et sur son oeil droit! Que son bras se dessèche, Et que son oeil droit s''éteigne!
verses.am: መንጋውን ለሚተው ለምናምንቴ እረኛ ወዮለት! ሰይፍ በክንዱና በቀኝ ዓይኑ ላይ ይሆናል፤ ክንዱም አጥብቃ ትደርቃለች፥ ቀኝ ዓይኑም ፈጽሞ ትጨልማለች።

verses.en: The burden of the word of the Lord for Israel, saith the Lord, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
verses.fr: Oracle, parole de l''Eternel sur Israël. Ainsi parle l''Eternel, qui a étendu les cieux et fondé la terre, Et qui a formé l''esprit de l''homme au dedans de lui:
verses.am: ስለ እስራኤል የተነገረ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሸክም ይህ ነው። ሰማያትን የዘረጋ፥ ምድርንም የመሠረተ፥ የሰውንም መንፈስ በውስጡ የሠራ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Voici, je ferai de Jérusalem une coupe d''étourdissement Pour tous les peuples d''alentour, Et aussi pour Juda dans le siège de Jérusalem.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን በዙሪያዋ ላሉት ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የመንገድገድ ዋንጫ አደርጋታለሁ፤ ደግሞም ኢየሩሳሌም ስትከበብ በይሁዳ ላይ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, je ferai de Jérusalem une pierre pesante pour tous les peuples; Tous ceux qui la soulèveront seront meurtris; Et toutes les nations de la terre s''assembleront contre elle.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ኢየሩሳሌምን ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ከባድ ድንጋይ አደርጋታለሁ፤ የሚሸከሙአት ሁሉ እጅግ ይቈስላሉ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ በላይዋ ላይ ይከማቻሉ።

verses.en: In that day, saith the Lord, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel, Je frapperai d''étourdissement tous les chevaux, Et de délire ceux qui les monteront; Mais j''aurai les yeux ouverts sur la maison de Juda, Quand je frapperai d''aveuglement tous les chevaux des peuples.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ፈረስን ሁሉ በድንጋጤ፥ ተቀማጭንም በእብድነት እመታለሁ፤ ዓይኖቼንም በይሁዳ ላይ እከፍታለሁ፥ የአሕዛብንም ፈረሶች ሁሉ በዕውርነት እመታለሁ።

verses.en: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the Lord of hosts their God.
verses.fr: Les chefs de Juda diront en leur coeur: Les habitants de Jérusalem sont notre force, Par l''Eternel des armées, leur Dieu.
verses.am: የይሁዳም አለቆች በልባቸው። በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ በአምላካቸው በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ብርታት አለ ይላሉ።

verses.en: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, je ferai des chefs de Juda Comme un foyer ardent parmi du bois, Comme une torche enflammée parmi des gerbes; Ils dévoreront à droite et à gauche tous les peuples d''alentour, Et Jérusalem restera à sa place, à Jérusalem.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን የይሁዳን አለቆች በእንጨት መካከል እንዳለ ትንታግ፥ በነዶችም መካከል እንዳለ እንደ ፋና ነበልባል አደርጋቸዋለሁ፤ በቀኝና በግራ በዙሪያ ያሉትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይበላሉ፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ ኢየሩሳሌም በስፍራዋ በኢየሩሳሌም ትኖራለች።

verses.en: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel sauvera d''abord les tentes de Juda, Afin que la gloire de la maison de David, La gloire des habitants de Jérusalem ne s''élève pas au-dessus de Juda.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የዳዊት ቤት ክብርና የኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች ክብር በይሁዳ ክብር ላይ እንዳይታበይ የይሁዳን ድንኳኖች አስቀድሞ ያድናል።

verses.en: In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, l''Eternel protégera les habitants de Jérusalem, Et le faible parmi eux sera dans ce jour comme David; La maison de David sera comme Dieu, Comme l''ange de l''Eternel devant eux.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን እግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩት ይመክትላቸዋል፤ በዚያም ቀን ከእነርሱ መካከል ደካማው እንደ ዳዊት ይሆናል፤ የዳዊትም ቤት በፊታቸው እንደ እግዚአብሔር መልአክ እንደ አምላክ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, Je m''efforcerai de détruire toutes les nations Qui viendront contre Jérusalem.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ የሚመጡትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለማጥፋት እጋደላለሁ።

verses.en: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
verses.fr: Alors je répandrai sur la maison de David et sur les habitants de Jérusalem Un esprit de grâce et de supplication, Et ils tourneront les regards vers moi, celui qu''ils ont percé. Ils pleureront sur lui comme on pleure sur un fils unique, Ils pleureront amèrement sur lui comme on pleure sur un premier-né.
verses.am: በዳዊትም ቤት ላይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሚኖሩት ላይ፥ የሞገስንና የልመናን መንፈስ አፈስሳለሁ፤ ወደ እርሱም ወደ ወጉት ይመለከታሉ፤ ሰውም ለአንድያ ልጁ እንደሚያለቅስ ያለቅሱለታል፥ ሰውም ለበኵር ልጁ እንደሚያዝን በመራራ ኀዘን ያዝኑለታል።

verses.en: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, le deuil sera grand à Jérusalem, Comme le deuil d''Hadadrimmon dans la vallée de Meguiddon.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን በመጊዶን ሜዳ እንደ ነበረው እንደ ሐዳድሪሞን ልቅሶ ታላቅ ልቅሶ በኢየሩሳሌም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.fr: Le pays sera dans le deuil, chaque famille séparément: La famille de la maison de David séparément, et les femmes à part; La famille de la maison de Nathan séparément, et les femmes à part;
verses.am: ምድሪቱም ታለቅሳለች፤ እያንዳንዱ ወገን ለብቻው፥ የዳዊት ቤት ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤ የናታን ቤት ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤

verses.en: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
verses.fr: La famille de la maison de Lévi séparément, et les femmes à part; La famille de Schimeï séparément, et les femmes à part;
verses.am: የሌዊ ቤት ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤ የሰሜኢ ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው፤

verses.en: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.fr: Toutes les autres familles, chaque famille séparément, Et les femmes à part.
verses.am: የቀሩት ወገኖች ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ወገን ለብቻው፥ ሴቶቻቸውም ለብቻቸው ያለቅሳሉ።

verses.en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, une source sera ouverte Pour la maison de David et les habitants de Jérusalem, Pour le péché et pour l''impureté.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ለዳዊት ቤትና በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ ከኃጢአትና ከርኵሰት የሚያነጻ ምንጭ ይከፈታል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel des armées, J''exterminerai du pays les noms des idoles, Afin qu''on ne s''en souvienne plus; J''ôterai aussi du pays les prophètes et l''esprit d''impureté.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ የጣዖታትን ስም ከምድር አጠፋለሁ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ አይታሰቡም፤ ደግሞም ሐሰተኞችን ነቢያትና ርኩስ መንፈስን ከምድር ላይ አስወግዳለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the Lord: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un prophétise encore, Son père et sa mère, qui l''ont engendré, lui diront: Tu ne vivras pas, car tu dis des mensonges au nom de l''Eternel! Et son père et sa mère, qui l''ont engendré, le transperceront Quand il prophétisera.
verses.am: ማንም ደግሞ ትንቢት ቢናገር የወለዱት አባቱና እናቱ። አንተ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ሐሰትን ተናግረሃልና በሕይወት አትኖርም ይሉታል፤ ትንቢትንም ሲናገር የወለዱት አባቱና እናቱ ይወጉታል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, les prophètes rougiront de leurs visions Quand ils prophétiseront, Et ils ne revêtiront plus un manteau de poil pour mentir.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ነቢያቱ ሁሉ ትንቢትን ሲናገሩ እያንዳንዱ ስለ ራእዩ ያፍራል፤ ያታልሉም ዘንድ የማቅ ልብስ አይለብሱም።

verses.en: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
verses.fr: Chacun d''eux dira: Je ne suis pas prophète, Je suis laboureur, Car on m''a acheté dès ma jeunesse.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሮ ባሪያ ሆኜ ነበርሁና ገበሬ ሰው ነኝ እንጂ ነቢይ አይደለሁም ይላል።

verses.en: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
verses.fr: Et si on lui demande: D''où viennent ces blessures que tu as aux mains? Il répondra: C''est dans la maison de ceux qui m''aimaient que je les ai reçues.
verses.am: ሰውም። ይህ በእጅህ መካከል ያለ ቍስል ምንድር ነው? ይለዋል። እርሱም። በወዳጆቼ ቤት የቈሰልሁት ቍስል ነው ይላል።

verses.en: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the Lord of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
verses.fr: Epée, lève-toi sur mon pasteur Et sur l''homme qui est mon compagnon! Dit l''Eternel des armées. Frappe le pasteur, et que les brebis se dispersent! Et je tournerai ma main vers les faibles.
verses.am: ሰይፍ ሆይ፥ ባልንጀራዬ በሆነው ሰው በእረኛዬ ላይ ንቃ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ እረኛውን ምታ፥ በጎቹም ይበተናሉ፤ እጄንም በታናናሾች ላይ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.
verses.fr: Dans tout le pays, dit l''Eternel, Les deux tiers seront exterminés, périront, Et l''autre tiers restera.
verses.am: በምድርም ሁሉ ላይ ሁለት ክፍል ተቈርጠው ይሞታሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ሦስተኛውም ክፍል በእርስዋ ውስጥ ይቀራል።

verses.en: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.
verses.fr: Je mettrai ce tiers dans le feu, Et je le purifierai comme on purifie l''argent, Je l''éprouverai comme on éprouve l''or. Il invoquera mon nom, et je l''exaucerai; Je dirai: C''est mon peuple! Et il dira: L''Eternel est mon Dieu!
verses.am: ሦስተኛውንም ክፍል ወደ እሳት አገባለሁ፥ ብርም እንደሚነጥር አነጥራቸዋለሁ፥ ወርቅም እንደሚፈተን እፈትናቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ስሜን ይጠራሉ፥ እኔም እሰማቸዋለሁ፤ እኔም። ይህ ሕዝቤ ነው እላለሁ፤ እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ነው ይላል።

verses.en: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
verses.fr: Voici, le jour de l''Eternel arrive, Et tes dépouilles seront partagées au milieu de toi.
